title: Gallery
intro_md: Here's Phobos in action, with PSP games at 4x, my Retroid Pocket 6 and the desktop program.

groups.title: In motion
groups.intro_md: PSP games at 4x on Vulkan (fast), run from saved scenes in the headless runner. No sound, just hit play.

items.caption_md: 8 seconds of gameplay in a wrecked street.

groups.title: One game per system, on my RP6
groups.intro_md: Recorded on my RP6 on 23 and 26 Oct, with nightlies 216052 and 216111. Nobody's playing, so it's mostly demos, intros and title screens. In a few, a script presses buttons on a timer. No sound, same as above.
